title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-18
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) (2) Sennheiser 421 + (1) Beyer M160 ->  Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape of a high‑energy show that cooks, highlighted by a smoking “Loser” and breakout “Crazy Fingers.”
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture praised as one of the best ever heard – surprisingly clear despite the backstage‑hacking setup. Musically the concert is described as “cooking,” with a powerful Loser solo, Phil’s booming bass run, and a standout Crazy Fingers jam that keep the energy high throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars and praise both performance and tape quality; only a couple of low‑star comments exist, so the weighted average is high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note exceptionally clear audience recording with well‑placed mics and minimal bleed; no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently high energy from start to finish, with the band staying loose and fun; transitions flow naturally.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Solo on Loser described as great, adding to the overall fire of the performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass run on Loser called a “killer solo” that punctuates the song.
